CanvasSection.description: An enumeration of the different sections of a business model canvas.
CanvasSection.title: CanvasSection

ERRCActionType.description: An enumeration of the different types of ERRC actions.
ERRCActionType.title: ERRCActionType

ErrcMove.description: Represents a move in the error correction system.

action.description: The action to be taken for error correction.

new_text.description: The new text to be used for the card after the action is applied, if applicable.
examples: Implement a new customer onboarding process
new_text.title: New Text

opposite_side_impact.description: A description of how the action will impact the opposite side of the canvas.
examples: Eliminating this feature may reduce customer satisfaction.
Raising the price may increase revenue but could decrease demand.
opposite_side_impact.title: Opposite Side Impact

rationale.description: The rationale behind the action, explaining why it is necessary.
examples: This feature is not aligned with our core value proposition.
Reducing production costs will improve our profit margins.
rationale.title: Rationale

target_card_text.description: The text of the card that the action targets, if applicable.
target_card_text.title: Target Card Text

target_section.description: The section of the canvas that the action targets.

ErrcMove.title: ErrcMove

description: Represents an error correction (ERRC) analysis for a business model canvas.

canvas_id.description: Identifier of the canvas this ERRC analysis is associated with.
canvas_id.title: Canvas Id

from_version.description: The version of the canvas from which this ERRC analysis is derived.
from_version.title: From Version

id.description: Unique identifier for the ERRC analysis.
id.title: Id

moves.description: The moves of the ERRC analysis: between 1 and 6.

examples.opposite_side_impact: Eliminating this segment may reduce revenue.
examples.rationale: This segment is no longer profitable.

examples.opposite_side_impact: Creating this proposition may attract new customers.
examples.rationale: This proposition addresses a new market need.

moves.title: Moves

result_canvas_id.description: Identifier of the resulting canvas after applying this ERRC analysis.
result_canvas_id.title: Result Canvas Id

swot_id.description: Identifier of the SWOT analysis whose signals informed these moves. SWOT always precedes ERRC in the swot_errc_cycle, so this is required, not optional.
swot_id.title: Swot Id

to_version.description: The version of the canvas to which this ERRC analysis is applied.
to_version.title: To Version

title: Errc
